text:
In the preparation of zinc sulfate crystals, excess zinc oxide is added to dilute sulfuric acid.
Why is an excess of zinc oxide added?
A
to make sure crystals are formed and not powder
B
to avoid filtering the mixture
C
to use up all of the sulfuric acid
D
to use up all of the zinc oxide

options.label: A
options.text: to make sure crystals are formed and not powder

options.label: C
options.text: to use up all of the sulfuric acid

options.label: D
options.text: to use up all of the zinc oxide
